title: LLM Eval Gates in CI, Not Slide Decks
excerpt: Demo-quality prompts do not survive production traffic. If evals live only in notebooks, every model swap becomes a product lottery.
description: Staff patterns for LLM evaluation in CI: golden datasets, regression thresholds, cost-aware sampling, and release gates that product teams can trust.
socialThreadTr: Notebook evals güven vermez; CI kapısı şart. 🧵

sections.heading: Evals are release infrastructure
paragraphs: Teams that only eyeball outputs before launch discover failures in support tickets. Eval harnesses turn subjective 'looks fine' into comparable scores across prompts, tools, and locales.
Version datasets like code. When someone edits a golden case without review, you lose the ability to detect model regressions versus intentional behavior changes.

sections.heading: Golden sets need ownership
paragraphs: Start with a small, high-signal golden set tied to revenue or compliance paths—not hundreds of vague prompts copied from marketing.
Each case should assert tool shape, citation presence, refusal behavior, or numeric bounds—not poetic similarity alone.
points: Treat eval suites like unit tests with fixtures and versioned datasets
Block releases on regression thresholds, not single lucky runs
Separate offline eval from online shadow traffic
Publish eval dashboards next to error budgets

sections.heading: Sample online, gate offline
paragraphs: CI should run fast eval subsets on every PR and fuller suites nightly. Expensive judge models belong in scheduled jobs, not every push.
Shadow traffic in production complements offline eval; it should not replace gates because incidents are already user-visible.

sections.heading: Make regressions visible
paragraphs: Publish eval trends beside latency and cost. When a model upgrade wins on quality score but doubles token spend, product should see that trade in one dashboard.
Eval gates earn the right to change models without heroics on launch night.

tr.title: LLM Eval Kapıları CI'da, Slayt Değil
tr.excerpt: Demo kalitesinde prompt'lar prod trafiğinde çöker. Eval yalnızca notebook'ta yaşarsa her model değişimi ürün piyangosu olur.
tr.description: CI'da LLM değerlendirme için staff kalıpları: golden veri setleri, regresyon eşikleri, maliyet duyarlı örnekleme ve ürünün güvenebileceği release kapıları.

sections.heading: Eval'ler release altyapısıdır
paragraphs: Yalnızca gözle kontrol eden ekipler hataları destek ticket'larında görür. Eval harness'leri 'iyi görünüyor'u prompt, tool ve locale boyunca karşılaştırılabilir skorlara çevirir.
Veri setlerini kod gibi versiyonlayın; onaysız golden case düzenlemesi model regresyonunu davranış değişikliğinden ayıramaz.

sections.heading: Golden set'in sahibi olmalı
paragraphs: Gelir veya uyum yollarına bağlı küçük, yüksek sinyalli golden set ile başlayın—pazarlama kopyasından yüzlerce belirsiz prompt değil.
Her vaka tool şekli, atıf, red davranışı veya sayısal sınır assert etmeli; yalnızca benzerlik skoru yetmez.
points: Treat eval suites like unit tests with fixtures and versioned datasets
Block releases on regression thresholds, not single lucky runs
Separate offline eval from online shadow traffic
Publish eval dashboards next to error budgets

sections.heading: Online örnekle, offline kilitle
paragraphs: CI her PR'da hızlı eval alt kümesi, gece tam suite çalıştırmalı. Pahalı judge modeller zamanlanmış job'larda olmalı, her push'ta değil.
Prod shadow trafik offline eval'i tamamlar; kapının yerini tutmaz çünkü olay zaten kullanıcıya görünür.

sections.heading: Regresyonları görünür kıl
paragraphs: Eval trendlerini gecikme ve maliyetin yanında yayınlayın. Model yükseltmesi kalite skorunu kazanıp token maliyetini ikiye katlarsa ürün tek panoda görmeli.
Eval kapıları, lansman gecesi kahramanlık olmadan model değiştirme hakkı verir.

de.title: LLM-Eval-Gates in der CI, nicht in Folien
de.excerpt: Demo-Prompts scheitern im Produktionsverkehr. Leben Evals nur in Notebooks, wird jeder Modelltausch zur Lotterie.
de.description: Staff-Muster für LLM-Eval in CI: Golden Sets, Regressionsschwellen, kostenbewusstes Sampling und Release-Gates.

sections.heading: Evals sind Release-Infrastruktur
paragraphs: Wer nur visuell prüft, findet Fehler in Support-Tickets. Eval-Harnesses machen aus 'sieht ok' vergleichbare Scores über Prompts, Tools und Locales.
Datensätze wie Code versionieren; unreviewte Golden-Case-Edits verblenden Modell-Regressionen.

sections.heading: Golden Sets brauchen Owner
paragraphs: Klein starten: hochsignal Golden Set an Revenue- oder Compliance-Pfaden.
Jeder Fall assertiert Tool-Form, Zitation, Refusal oder numerische Grenzen—not nur Ähnlichkeit.
points: Treat eval suites like unit tests with fixtures and versioned datasets
Block releases on regression thresholds, not single lucky runs
Separate offline eval from online shadow traffic
Publish eval dashboards next to error budgets

sections.heading: Online sampeln, offline sperren
paragraphs: CI: schnelle Eval-Teilmenge pro PR, volle Suite nachts. Teure Judge-Modelle in Jobs, nicht jeden Push.
Shadow-Traffic ergänzt offline Eval, ersetzt Gates nicht.

sections.heading: Regressionen sichtbar machen
paragraphs: Eval-Trends neben Latenz und Kosten publizieren. Qualitätsgewinn bei doppelten Token-Kosten muss sichtbar sein.
Eval-Gates erlauben Modellwechsel ohne Launch-Heldentum.

fr.title: Portes d'eval LLM en CI, pas en slides
fr.excerpt: Les prompts démo s'effondrent en prod. Si les evals vivent seulement dans des notebooks, chaque swap modèle devient loterie.
fr.description: Patterns staff : jeux golden, seuils de régression, échantillonnage coût-aware et gates de release fiables.

sections.heading: Les evals sont infra de release
paragraphs: Les équipes qui eyeballent avant launch découvrent les échecs au support. Les harness transforment 'ça a l'air bien' en scores comparables.
Versionner les datasets comme le code ; éditer un golden sans review aveugle les régressions.

sections.heading: Les golden sets ont un owner
paragraphs: Commencer petit : golden set à fort signal sur chemins revenue ou compliance.
Chaque cas assert forme d'outil, citation, refus ou bornes—not seulement similarité.
points: Treat eval suites like unit tests with fixtures and versioned datasets
Block releases on regression thresholds, not single lucky runs
Separate offline eval from online shadow traffic
Publish eval dashboards next to error budgets

sections.heading: Échantillonner online, verrouiller offline
paragraphs: CI : sous-ensemble rapide à chaque PR, suite complète la nuit. Juges coûteux en jobs planifiés.
Le shadow prod complète l'eval offline ; ne remplace pas les gates.

sections.heading: Rendre les régressions visibles
paragraphs: Publier tendances eval à côté latence et coût. Un upgrade qualité qui double les tokens doit être visible.
Les gates eval permettent de changer de modèle sans héroïsme de launch.

it.title: Gate di eval LLM in CI, non slide
it.excerpt: I prompt da demo crollano in produzione. Eval solo in notebook rende ogni cambio modello una lotteria.
it.description: Pattern staff per eval LLM in CI: golden set, soglie regressione, campionamento cost-aware e gate di release.

sections.heading: Gli eval sono infrastruttura di release
paragraphs: Chi controlla a occhio scopre i fallimenti nei ticket. Gli harness trasformano 'sembra ok' in punteggi comparabili su prompt, tool e locale.
Versiona i dataset come codice; edit golden senza review offusca regressioni modello.

sections.heading: I golden set hanno un owner
paragraphs: Parti piccolo: golden ad alto segnale su percorsi revenue o compliance.
Ogni caso assert forma tool, citazione, rifiuto o bound numerici—not solo similarità.
points: Treat eval suites like unit tests with fixtures and versioned datasets
Block releases on regression thresholds, not single lucky runs
Separate offline eval from online shadow traffic
Publish eval dashboards next to error budgets

sections.heading: Campiona online, blocca offline
paragraphs: CI: subset veloce ogni PR, suite piena di notte. Judge costosi in job schedulati.
Shadow in prod completa eval offline, non sostituisce i gate.

sections.heading: Rendi visibili le regressioni
paragraphs: Pubblica trend eval accanto a latenza e costo. Upgrade qualità che raddoppia token deve essere visibile.
I gate eval permettono cambio modello senza eroi alla launch.

zh.title: CI 中的 LLM 评测门，而非幻灯片
zh.excerpt: 演示级 prompt 扛不住生产流量。评测若只活在 notebook，每次换模型都是产品抽奖。
zh.description: CI 中 LLM 评测的 staff 模式：黄金集、回归阈值、成本敏感抽样与可信赖发布门。

sections.heading: 评测是发布基础设施
paragraphs: 只肉眼验收的团队在工单里发现失败。评测 harness 把“看起来还行”变成可比分。
数据集像代码一样版本化；未审 golden 编辑会混淆模型回归与行为变更。

sections.heading: 黄金集需要负责人
paragraphs: 从小而高信号 golden 集起步，绑 revenue 或合规路径。
每例应断言工具形态、引用、拒绝或数值界，而非仅相似度。
points: Treat eval suites like unit tests with fixtures and versioned datasets
Block releases on regression thresholds, not single lucky runs
Separate offline eval from online shadow traffic
Publish eval dashboards next to error budgets

sections.heading: 在线抽样、离线门禁
paragraphs: CI 每 PR 跑快评子集，夜间全量；贵 judge 放定时任务。
生产 shadow 补充离线评测，不能替代门禁。

sections.heading: 让回归可见
paragraphs: 评测趋势与延迟、成本同屏。质量升而 token 翻倍须在一张盘里可见。
评测门让你无需 launch 夜英雄式换模型。

ja.title: スライドではなくCIのLLM評価ゲート
ja.excerpt: デモ品質プロンプトは本番トラフィックで崩れる。評価がノートブックだけならモデル差し替えは宝くじになる。
ja.description: CIでのLLM評価：ゴールデンセット、回帰閾値、コスト意識サンプリング、信頼できるリリースゲート。

sections.heading: Evalはリリース基盤
paragraphs: 目視だけのチームはサポートチケットで失敗に気づく。Harnessは「良さそう」を比較可能スコアに。
データセットをコード同様バージョン管理；未レビューgolden編集は回帰検知を壊す。

sections.heading: ゴールデンセットにオーナー
paragraphs: 小さく高信号のゴールデンから。収益・コンプライアンス経路に紐づける。
各ケースはツール形状・引用・拒否・数値境界をassert；類似度だけでは不足。
points: Treat eval suites like unit tests with fixtures and versioned datasets
Block releases on regression thresholds, not single lucky runs
Separate offline eval from online shadow traffic
Publish eval dashboards next to error budgets

sections.heading: オンラインでサンプル、オフラインでゲート
paragraphs: CIはPRごとに高速サブセット、夜間フル。高コストジャッジはスケジュールジョブ。
本番シャドウはオフラインevalを補完しゲートの代わりにならない。

sections.heading: 回帰を可視化
paragraphs: evalトレンドをレイテンシ・コスト横に公開。品質向上でトークン2倍なら一枚の盤で見えるべき。
Evalゲートはローンチ夜のヒーローなしでモデル変更を可能にする。
